title: Armorburn
summary: Armorburn is a fiery spell that creates a burning red aura around the user. This aura inflicts burns to anything or anyone touching it. It is the fire equivalent to the cold spell Chillskin, which is regularly used to counter Armorburn. This spell is used by Kiel.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Kiel used Armorburn on Medusa's Island to fight against Sophie Casterwill. [Zhalia's Mission]

Kiel used the spell to destroy the door to the Cloisters. [The Casterwill Connection]

Kiel used the spell in hand to hand combat against Dante Vale. Dante used the spell Chillskin to counter its burning effect. [The Spiral War]
